question.text: A car insurance premium is analogous to which option concept?

answer.text: The option premium paid by the option buyer
The strike price of the option
The intrinsic value of the option

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 67 of the source defines the option premium as the price the buyer pays the seller, and pages 67-68 state explicitly that a car insurance premium is an option premium in the form of an insurance premium — both buy downside protection. The Trap: The strike price, intrinsic value and delta describe different option mechanics; only the premium is the upfront price for the protection. Note: The put-option / warranty analogy on pages 67-68 reinforces that an insurance premium maps to the cost paid for optional future protection.
